description:
Eating well and training are easier with someone on your side. CaliPartner is an Indian food calorie tracker and accountability app with partner rooms to keep you consistent.

Track what you eat
• Log breakfast, lunch, dinner and snacks
• Search Indian foods: roti, dal, sabzi, idli, paneer, biryani and more
• Scan barcodes, create custom foods, save My meals and re-log combinations
• See calories, protein, carbs and fat against your daily target
• Log water, track steps and record outdoor runs with foreground GPS

Train and move
• Log exercises, sets, reps and weight
• Review your running route, distance and pace
• Plus and Pro include a private progress photo vault on your device

Keep each other going
• Free can host a room for two
• Share the progress you choose and chat with your squad
• Build streaks and compare consistency against your own goals
• Plus and Pro include pair challenges

Go further with Plus and Pro
• Plus: larger rooms, 90+ Indian recipes, fasting tracker and custom macro targets
• Purchased Plus and Pro: AI meal and workout plans, with your consent
• Purchased Pro: personal AI coach, AI photo food logging, chat-to-log, monthly progress reviews, room media sharing and priority support
• Review AI estimates before saving. Target changes require your acceptance

Safe by design
Targets include calorie floors and weekly rate caps. CaliPartner is not medical advice. Consult a doctor or dietitian before changing your diet or training. Logging requires an internet connection. Progress photos stay on your device without CaliPartner cloud backup.

Eligible accounts can activate a 7-day Plus trial with no card and no automatic charge. Full AI plans are excluded from the trial. Pro has no trial. Paid Plus and Pro purchases bill immediately at the price and duration shown before purchase and renew automatically unless cancelled. Manage or cancel through your store account settings, or your billing provider for web purchases. Account deletion does not cancel subscriptions.
